overview.title: What is 99 Nights in the Forest?
paragraphs: 99 Nights in the Forest is a co-op survival game on Roblox by Grandma's Favourite Games. You join up to 24 other players around a campfire, gather wood and food during the day, and try to stay alive for 99 in-game nights while things hunt you in the dark.

Every run follows the same shape: keep the fire burning, rescue the missing children, manage hunger, and push further out each night for better loot. This wiki focuses on the decisions that decide whether you reach night 20 or night 99 — which class to buy, which fights to take, and which mistakes to avoid.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about 99 Nights in the Forest.

items.q: What is 99 Nights in the Forest?
items.a: A free-to-play co-op survival game on Roblox made by Grandma's Favourite Games. You team up with other players around a campfire, gather resources by day, and try to survive 99 in-game nights while hostile entities hunt you after dark.

items.q: Which class should I buy first?
items.a: It depends on the role you want to play. Wood runners, medics and combat classes solve completely different problems for the camp. Compare every class by price and perk on the class comparison page before spending Diamonds — you cannot refund them.

No. The Deer cannot be killed in normal play. A flashlight stuns it briefly, which is your only reliable way to escape. Staying near light and keeping the campfire fed matters far more than fighting it.

items.q: Are there codes for 99 Nights in the Forest?
items.a: Yes, the developers release codes around updates and events, usually for Diamonds, Gems or Flames. Codes expire without warning, so redeem them as soon as you see them. The codes page lists what is currently working and what has just expired.

Buy the Taming Flute from the Tool Trader, find an animal you want, and win the balance minigame. Then feed it the food it asks for. A tamed wolf or bear fights alongside you, which makes night runs far less dangerous.

items.q: How do I find the missing kids?
items.a: Each of the missing children spawns in a different structure across the map. Rescue them early — they later unlock extra jobs and badges. The missing kids page lists every location in order.

items.q: Is 99 Nights in the Forest based on a true story?
items.a: Partly. It draws on the real story of four children who survived 40 days in the Amazon jungle after a plane crash in May 2023, mixed with Wendigo and Not Deer folklore. The true story page explains what is borrowed and what is invented.
Yes, Roblox runs on mobile and the game is playable there, although the controls are noticeably easier on desktop.
